explanation.en: 'European' begins with the consonant sound 'yu', so 'a' is used.
explanation.as: 'European' ৰ উচ্চাৰণ 'yu' ব্যঞ্জন ধ্বনিৰে আৰম্ভ হয়; সেয়ে 'a' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: 'The' is used before the names of rivers.
explanation.as: নদীৰ নামৰ আগত 'The' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: The plural of 'phenomenon' is 'phenomena'.
explanation.as: 'phenomenon' ৰ বহুবচন হৈছে 'phenomena'।

explanation.en: The plural of 'deer' is also 'deer'.
explanation.as: 'deer' ৰ বহুবচনও 'deer'।

explanation.en: The abstract noun of 'brave' is 'bravery'.
explanation.as: 'brave' ৰ ভাৱবাচক বিশেষ্য হৈছে 'bravery'।

q.en: A collective noun for a group of ships is:

explanation.en: 'Fleet' is the collective noun used for a group of ships.
explanation.as: জাহাজৰ গোটৰ বাবে ব্যৱহৃত collective noun হৈছে 'fleet'।

explanation.en: 'Whom' is used as the object of the verb 'give'.
explanation.as: 'give' ক্ৰিয়াৰ object হিচাপে 'whom' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: This is the house ___ roof is red.
q.as: এইটো সেই ঘৰটো যাৰ চালি ৰঙা।

explanation.en: 'Whose' shows possession and refers to 'the house's roof'.
explanation.as: 'whose' য়ে মালিকানা দেখুৱায় আৰু 'the house's roof' লৈ ইংগিত কৰে।

q.as: ল'ৰা-ছোৱালীবোৰ খেলি থাকোঁতে নিজকে আঘাত কৰিলে।

explanation.en: The correct reflexive pronoun for 'the children' is 'themselves'.
explanation.as: 'the children' ৰ বাবে শুদ্ধ reflexive pronoun হৈছে 'themselves'।

q.en: She and ___ went to the market.

explanation.en: The subject pronoun 'I' is used because it is part of the subject of the sentence.
explanation.as: বাক্যৰ কৰ্তাৰ অংশ হোৱাৰ বাবে subject pronoun 'I' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: The comparative degree of 'many' is 'more'.
explanation.as: 'many' ৰ তুলনামূলক ডিগ্ৰী হৈছে 'more'।

explanation.en: The superlative degree of 'well' is 'best'.
explanation.as: 'well' ৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ ডিগ্ৰী হৈছে 'best'।

explanation.en: The correct preposition after 'different' is 'from'.
explanation.as: 'different' ৰ পিছত শুদ্ধ preposition হৈছে 'from'।

explanation.en: 'Postponed until Monday' means the meeting is delayed to that time.
explanation.as: 'postponed until Monday' মানে সভাখন সেই সময়লৈ পিছলৈ ঠেলি দিয়া হৈছে।

explanation.en: The correlative conjunction pair is 'neither...nor'.
explanation.as: correlative conjunction ৰ যোৰ হৈছে 'neither...nor'।

explanation.en: 'Either' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'is'.
explanation.as: 'either' singular; সেয়ে ই singular verb 'is' লয়।

explanation.en: 'Yesterday' refers to past time, so the simple past 'met' is used.
explanation.as: 'yesterday' এ অতীত সময় বুজায়; সেয়ে simple past 'met' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: He ___ TV when I called him.
q.as: মই তেওঁক ফোন কৰোঁতে তেওঁ টি.ভি. ___।

explanation.en: The past continuous 'was watching' shows an action in progress when another past action happened.
explanation.as: past continuous 'was watching' য়ে আন এটা অতীত কাৰ্য ঘটোঁতে চলি থকা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়।

q.en: Change into passive voice: People speak English all over the world.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: People speak English all over the world.

options.en: English is spoken all over the world.
options.as: English is spoken all over the world.

options.en: English was spoken all over the world.
options.as: English was spoken all over the world.

options.en: English speaks all over the world.
options.as: English speaks all over the world.

options.en: English has spoken all over the world.
options.as: English has spoken all over the world.

explanation.en: The present simple passive is formed with 'is/are' plus the past participle.
explanation.as: present simple ৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'is/are' আৰু past participle ৰে গঠিত হয়।

q.en: Change into active voice: The report has been submitted by the committee.
q.as: কৰ্তৃবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: The report has been submitted by the committee.

options.en: The committee has submitted the report.
options.as: The committee has submitted the report.

options.en: The committee had submitted the report.
options.as: The committee had submitted the report.

explanation.en: The present perfect passive 'has been submitted' corresponds to the active 'has submitted'.
explanation.as: present perfect ৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'has been submitted' ৰ কৰ্তৃবাচ্য হৈছে 'has submitted'।

q.en: Change into indirect speech: She said, 'Where are you going?'
q.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: She said, 'Where are you going?'

options.en: She asked where I was going.
options.as: She asked where I was going.

options.en: She asked where was I going.
options.as: She asked where was I going.

options.en: She said where I was going.
options.as: She said where I was going.

options.en: She asked where I am going.
options.as: She asked where I am going.

explanation.en: A wh-question in indirect speech uses statement word order: 'where I was going'.
explanation.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিত wh-question এ statement ৰ word order লয়: 'where I was going'।

explanation.en: 'Could' is used to make a polite request.
explanation.as: ভদ্ৰভাৱে অনুৰোধ কৰিবলৈ 'could' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: 'Everyone' is treated as plural in a question tag, so 'haven't they' is used.
explanation.as: question tag ত 'everyone' ক plural হিচাপে ধৰা হয়; সেয়ে 'haven't they' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: If I were you, I ___ accept the offer.
q.as: যদি মই তোমাৰ ঠাইত থাকিলোহেঁতেন, মই প্ৰস্তাৱটো ___ গ্ৰহণ কৰিলোহেঁতেন।

explanation.en: The second conditional uses 'would' plus the base verb in the main clause.
explanation.as: second conditional ত main clause ত 'would' আৰু verb ৰ base form ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct negative sentence with 'doesn't':
q.as: 'doesn't' ৰ সৈতে শুদ্ধ ঋণাত্মক বাক্যটো বাছক:

explanation.en: After 'doesn't', the base form 'know' is used, not 'knows'.
explanation.as: 'doesn't' ৰ পিছত 'knows' নহয়, verb ৰ base form 'know' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।
